topics.name: Search Result Evidence
topics.purpose: Define ranked search results as derived evidence referencing exact source identities/revisions and score/ranking profile.

semantics.query_rule: Result set references exact search query.
semantics.source_rule: Every hit references exact source identity/revision.
semantics.score_rule: Score/relevance is derived evidence, not semantic truth.
semantics.snippet_rule: Snippets/highlights are derived and subject to source governance.
semantics.authority_rule: Search hit does not grant access to hidden fields/source mutations.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant identity, type, relation, state and meaning are explicit and never inferred solely from display text, path, layout, file order, timestamp or implementation accident.
Resolved, projected, indexed, cached, formatted or derived representations never become source-of-truth or authority merely because they are convenient or available.
